iterations.publicRationale: No hypotheses exist yet. Release 9.2.0 for Android changed CheckoutConfirmation and ReceiptScreen and went to full rollout just before the checkout completion drop (10:00-11:00), so I will frame competing explanations around the release change, a coincident upstream/dependency cause, and a measurement regression.

Comparing checkout_completion_rate by app_version on Android during the incident window will show whether the drop is isolated to 9.2.0 (supporting changed-flow hypotheses HYP-1/HYP-2) or also affects other Android versions (supporting external/dependency hypothesis HYP-3). If 9.2.0 is uniquely low, that discriminates HYP-1/HYP-2 from HYP-3; if older versions also drop, HYP-3 gains support.
先处理当前唯一待评估 Evidence：它是 incident 窗口内 Android 按 app_version 的 checkout_completion_rate 分群结果。结果为 9.2.0 显著低于 9.1.4，因此该证据只直接证明异常是 9.2.0 版本专属，尚未触及具体机制，对各假设的可支持程度需据此区分。

evidenceAssessments.explanation: 分群显示 9.2.0 的 checkout_completion_rate=0.61，而相同 Android 平台的旧版本 9.1.4=0.94，异常精确地落在新版发布之后的新版本上，符合 9.2.0 引入的 checkout_confirmation_v2 流程造成 Android 9.2.0 用户无法完成结账的预期。
该分群证据只说明完成率下降集中在 9.2.0，无法区分是用户在付款前放弃还是付款成功但 ReceiptScreen 导致完成事件漏计；它既不支持也不反驳 ReceiptScreen 机制。
该证据把异常隔离到 9.2.0 与 9.1.4 两个版本之间，既不能证明也不能排除后端/支付/外部依赖恰好只影响新版路径；需要 cart_add_rate 或支付环节观测来判断外部依赖是否参与。

competingHypothesisState.statement: The checkout_confirmation_v2 flow introduced in Android release 9.2.0 has a functional or UI regression that prevents Android 9.2.0 users from completing checkout.
The ReceiptScreen change in Android release 9.2.0 breaks post-payment return/confirmation handling, causing successful checkouts to be undercounted even though payments are being completed.

A backend, payment-provider, or dependency issue coinciding with the 9.2.0 rollout, rather than the app code change itself, caused checkout completion to fail only for users on the newly released Android version.

expected.rootCause: The Android 9.2.0 release regressed checkout confirmation behavior.

audit.decisionReason: Runtime failure is excluded from automatic root-cause correctness.

Compare Web search query volume during the breach window against its baseline. Stable or defined query volume would weaken HYP-3 composition/degradation-of-session-mix and point toward functional failure in HYP-1/HYP-2; sharply changed volume would keep segment-composition explanations viable. If EMPTY/no-data is returned, no volume inference is possible and next step will pivot to user feedback or similar incidents.

用户反馈能提供机制层证据，帮助区分 REL-202 引入的 transport/RequestBudget 回归（HYP-57）与后端/网络性能故障（HYP-252）以及会话构成偏移（HYP-dd47）。若反馈集中在 web-31.4 且描述查询发起后被中止/超时，将支持 HYP-57 并削弱另两者；若反馈描述后端全局慢查询/错误或多版本受影响，将支持 HYP-252；若几乎无反馈或反馈指向正常搜索后放弃，则难以支持功能缺陷并可能支持构成偏移。该调用直接面向事发窗口和受影响版本用户，具有判别力。

先处理未评估的当前事件用户反馈证据：EU-09b4 对应事发窗口 web-31.4 Web 用户报告 'request timed out' 与 'results disappear after several seconds'，与 REL-202 transport/RequestBudget 导致的请求中止/超时机制相容，因而支持 HYP-57；该反馈并不提供多版本/多平台或独立后端时序信息，无法确认 HYP-252 的外部依赖故障假设，也不反映低完成率会话构成偏移，故对其余两个假设均保持中性。

HYP-57（REL-202 的 SearchTransport/RequestBudget 回归）已获当前事件支持，但还缺机制类证据；HYP-252（后端或网络性能故障，发布仅时间相关）与 HYP-57 在“是否局限于 web-31.4 且由 transport/budget 逻辑引发”上互相排斥。检索历史相似事故可按 version=web-31.4、platform=Web 和 search_completion_rate 区分释因：若历史事故指向同样的 web-31.4 transport/budget 超时则显著支持 HYP-57 并削弱 HYP-252；若显示多版本/平台同时受影响则支持 HYP-252；若返回无关或无匹配则按当前证据趋向收敛。
必须先评估待处理的历史事故证据（EV-6ce6d376）。该证据仅提供一条历史相似事故标题'Index saturation during a seasonal catalog import'，未提供多版本/多平台共现、当前事件时间对齐或代码变更关联，因此对三个假说均不构成支持或反驳，全部标记为 NEUTRAL。

Previous feedback was filtered to web-31.4, masking whether timeouts also affect other Web versions. Broadening search_user_feedback to all Web versions for the incident window will distinguish a release-specific regression (H1) from a platform-wide backend/network failure (H2). If older/non-changed versions also show timeouts, H2 gains current-incident support and H1 is contradicted; if only web-31.4 appears, H1 remains the leading explanation and H2 can be rejected.

iterations.publicRationale: No competing hypotheses exist yet for crash-free session drop isolated to staged iOS 12.0.0 cohort. Proposed alternatives center on the changed DeepLinkRouter module, staged-cohort composition/measurement artifact, and external/OS-level crash causes to allow later discrimination via release facts, feedback, and segment evidence.
当前无任何已收集证据。该查询按 app_version 对 iOS 的 crash_free_session_rate 分组，可检验异常是否仅存在于 12.0.0（支持版本内代码缺陷或该版本特有外部因素）还是在多个 iOS 版本同时出现（支持测量/环境因素）。它直接区分 HYP-1/HYP-3 与 HYP-2，并为后续归因提供分段基线；若返回 EMPTY 则转向用户反馈证据。

Process pending segment_metric evidence before planning next tool call. The breakdown isolates the crash-free dip to appVersion 12.0.0 (0.89, n=900) against healthy 11.9.2 (0.995, n=3100) on iOS, which is consistent with a code-induced defect but does not yet link it to DeepLinkRouter; it also does not discriminate artifact/environment hypotheses without additional feedback or context.

This feedback search differentiates the DeepLinkRouter defect hypothesis (HYP-6bab70b1) from the staged-cohort/instrumentation artifact hypothesis (HYP-54914514) and external environmental hypothesis (HYP-67050db2). SUCCESS: reports of crashes or deep-link failures on iOS 12.0.0 during the incident window would support HYP-6bab70b1 and contradict HYP-54914514; reports tied to OS/network/region rather than routing would support HYP-67050db2. After evaluating results I will assess all three hypotheses and either FINALIZE if one clearly wins or continue with a discriminating segment_metric slice (e.g., user_type or region) if evidence remains ambiguous. EMPTY/NO_MATCH: no user-facing crash or deep-link symptom reports would weaken the code-defect mechanism and favor the artifact/external explanations, leading me to request a different segment dimension or STOP_INCONCLUSIVE if no further discriminating query shape is available.

The pending user feedback evidence contains a single unrelated UI polish issue (settings label truncation on small screen) rather than any crash or deep-link report, so it lacks discriminating power across the three hypotheses and must be marked neutral for all.

evidenceAssessments.explanation: Shows crash-free-session loss is isolated to appVersion 12.0.0 while 11.9.2 remains healthy on the same platform, matching the staged-code-defect signature; it does not yet confirm DeepLinkRouter as the cause.
The version-specific concentration is also compatible with a version-bound instrumentation or cohort artifact, so this observation neither confirms nor refutes the non-code artifact explanation.

No platform/OS/region/network variable beyond iOS is present in this breakdown, so it cannot yet distinguish an external environmental cause from code or artifact explanations; absence of impact on 11.9.2 is only weak context.
The feedback is about truncated settings label text, not a crash or deep-link failure; it does not confirm the DeepLinkRouter crash mechanism and is too weak and off-target to refute it.
A non-crash UI rendering issue neither supports nor refutes the staged-rollout composition/instrumentation artifact explanation for the crash-free-session drop.
The feedback is unrelated to platform/OS/region/network factors and does not provide any signal about an external environmental cause.

competingHypothesisState.statement: A defect introduced in iOS 12.0.0's DeepLinkRouter changes causes crashes during deep-link handling, lowering crash-free session rate only in the staged iOS cohort.

The staged iOS 12.0.0 cohort's lower crash-free session rate is not caused by new app code but by a composition or instrumentation artifact of the staged rollout (e.g., session-counting/SDK issue or biased user segment), not a genuine crash defect.

An external or environmental factor (e.g., iOS-specific OS incompatibility, third-party service failure, or region/network condition) disproportionately crashes sessions for the staged iOS 12.0.0 cohort, independent of the DeepLinkRouter code change.

expected.rootCause: The staged iOS 12.0.0 release introduced a crash regression.
